issues.issue: Did the Officer reasonably refuse the TRP and study permit, given evidence of childhood attempted sexual assault and risks in Nigeria?
issues.applicant_position: Officer gave no reasons why TRP unjustified and ignored evidence of harm in Nigeria, including childhood assault.
issues.respondent_position: Factual error is not material or fatal to warrant judicial intervention.
issues.result_text: Officer overlooked childhood assault evidence, material to Nigerian risk; application allowed, decision set aside.
